title: Hawk's Reckoning of the Paired Cord
summary: Teaches a Xiantian student to stoop on a quarry with paired cords, drop from height and close both loops together.

title: The River Court Garrote Memorial
summary: A formal memorial of slow river-pressure garroting, with the court bow, the weir snare and the drowning pull.

title: Treatise of the Azure Throat Line
summary: Studies the single line across the throat, from the feigned half draw to a qi stroke that leaves no wound.

title: Dual-Track Doctrine of the Silent Cord
summary: Teaches the body track and qi track together so a target is taken without sound, shout or qi surge.

title: The Basin Night Garrote Canon
summary: Collects the night methods of the basin schools, with cloaked casts, hidden dragnets and a vanishing step behind the target.

title: Twin-Stream Book of the Closing Loop
summary: Sets two streams of qi along two cords that merge at the neck, ending in the twin torrent draw.

title: Wind-Sworn Canon of the Unwalled Cord
summary: A Gale canon for fighting in open country with no wall at the back, where the cord alone guards the front.

title: The Oath of the Gale Loop
summary: Binds the student by oath to a single loop thrown on a sworn bearing and held against the strongest gust.

title: Bearing Treatise of the Last Draw
summary: Teaches taking a fixed bearing on a target and finishing with one last unbroken draw at the throat.

title: Plateau Rites of the Long Wind Cord
summary: Preserves the plateau rites for a long cord flung on the wind and guided by field qi over great reach.

title: Doctrine of the Open Gale Cord
summary: Sets out a doctrine of open-handed gusting pulls and wind-borne casts for Xiantian Gale students.

title: Book of the Gale-Taken Throat
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn way of taking a throat in a single gust-timed draw, from first approach to the sealing close.
